ruled_out_vectors.reason: 512-bit multiply via CRT+Newton-Raphson handles phantom overflow correctly. Fuzz verified: mulDivRoundingUp >= mulDiv for all inputs. mulDiv(max,max,max) = max.
getNextSqrtPriceFromInput correctly decreases price for zeroForOne and increases for oneForZero. Zero input returns same price.
Equal prices produce zero deltas. Rounding is consistent: roundUp >= roundDown verified. Positive liquidity always gives non-negative deltas.
100% fee: amountIn=0, output=0 (correct). 0% fee: feeAmount=0 (correct). 1-wei input: amountIn+feeAmount<=1 (no free tokens). At tick boundary: feeAmount=ceil(A*fee/(MAX-fee)) is consistent.
getSqrtPriceAtTick -> getTickAtSqrtPrice round-trip verified at every 1000th tick from MIN_TICK to MAX_TICK. getTickAtSqrtPrice returns floor(tick), so recovered tick is in [tick-1, tick].
MSB and LSB verified for all 256 powers of 2. MSB(1)=0, MSB(max)=255.
Correct revert on underflow (100+(-101)), overflow (max+max), exact zero (100+(-100)). Normal operations produce correct results.

Output fee formula uses mulDivRoundingUp(input, feeBPS, MAX_BPS-feeBPS). feeBPS < MAX_BPS enforced for output swaps (strict <). Protocol fee also rounds UP; unchecked subtraction safe because protocolFee = ceil(fee * protBPS / MAX) <= fee when protBPS <= MAX_BPS.

Input fee rounds DOWN (user pays less). Output fee rounds UP (user pays more). Both consistent: user never benefits from rounding. Fee=100 on 1M: input = floor(1M*100/10000) = 10000. Output = ceil(990000*100/9900) = 10001. Output always >= input.

ruled_out_vectors.reason: Both-zero returns 2^96 (1:1). Only-amount1-zero returns MIN_SQRT_RATIO. Only-amount0-zero returns MAX_SQRT_RATIO. For valid uint128 ratio inputs, the dynamic scaling while-loop prevents overflow; max result ~2^224 < 2^256, cannot trigger the >uint160 zero-return.
Fuzz test: swap A->B then B->A with random amounts. finalBalance <= initialBalance always. Fee + rounding compound loss.

ruled_out_vectors.reason: 100 alternating 1-wei swaps: pool never loses value. Each 1-wei swap produces 0 output (rounded down). Attacker loses all dust to fees.
110 tiny swaps A->B then swap all B->A: final balance <= initial balance. Compounding rounding losses make this strictly negative for the attacker.
20 sequential one-direction swaps: pool input token balance monotonically increases. Fee growth globals are non-decreasing by construction (addDelta never subtracts).
Two adjacent tick ranges with liquidity at 191140-191150 and 191150-191160. Large swap crossing boundary + reverse: finalBalance <= initialBalance.

ruled_out_vectors.reason: Swap right then left across tick 191150: both directions complete without revert. Third swap succeeds, confirming state consistency after bidirectional crossings.

Check at L917-918 reverts if recalculated > initial. Unused input returned to user by AMM layer. No tokens created/destroyed.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FixedHelper dust accumulation in extreme-ratio pools
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Output dust bounded by ceil(price) per swap. For ratio 1e18:1, this is 1e18 wei of token0 = 1 unit of token1 at that ratio. Value = $1e-18 per swap for 18-decimal $1 tokens. Not economically significant even over 10000 swaps.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FixedHelper fee distribution across heights loses or creates tokens
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Iterative proportional distribution: floor(feeAmount*returnedAtHeight/amount) per height. Last iteration gets all remaining fee. Total always equals initial feeAmount exactly. Per-LP fee growth rounding loses at most 1 token unit per height per LP per swap — sub-wei for 18-decimal tokens.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: FixedHelper tmpSwapCache reference semantics cause fee miscalculation
ruled_out_vectors.reason: In Solidity, 'memory struct = memory struct' creates a reference (alias). At L1685, tmpSwapCache IS swapCache. Fee recalculation at L1688-1691 correctly modifies the original swapCache. Not a bug.

Complete token flow trace: all fees computed and transferred in tokenIn denomination. Exchange fee, feeOnTop, protocol fee, hook fees all in tokenIn. Output in tokenOut. No cross-denomination arithmetic. Balance check at L2208 validates exact amounts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook fees unbounded, draining swap amount
ruled_out_vectors.reason: For input swaps: hook fees bounded by remaining swapAmountIn (checks at L2616, L2629). Two sequential hooks can take the entire post-fee input. For output swaps: hook fees added to amounts with overflow checks. User protected by limitAmount. A malicious hook is admin-configured (self-inflicted config, FP #4).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill fee adjustment allows free swaps
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Exchange fee adjustment uses floor(feeAmount * amountInAdjustment / originalAmountIn) for the REFUND, not the remaining fee. With 1-wei actual fill on 1000-wei input with 30 fee: adjustment=floor(30*999/1000)=29, remaining fee=1. User pays 1 wei fee on 1 wei swap. Never zero (when original fee > 0 and actualAmount > 0). Max rounding error: 4 wei per partial fill.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill feeOnTop not adjusted — disproportionate fee
ruled_out_vectors.reason: feeOnTop is intentionally NOT adjusted during partial fills. It's a flat service fee, not proportional to fill. User protection: they set the feeOnTop amount themselves (or the executor does, capped by limitAmount). Cannot extract value — only the user/executor overpays.

_setReentrancyFlags(NO_FLAGS) at L3190 preserves the ENTERED bit (L68-72: strips only custom flags, reads ENTERED from storage, ORs back). Re-entrant calls hit L80 check and revert. ruled_out_vectors.reason: Even if fillPermittedOrderERC20 returns an error silently, the strict balance equality check at L2208 (balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter) catches any transfer failure. No tokens were received → check fails → swap reverts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: ETH refund reentrancy during wrapped native deposit
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Refund at L3253 sends native ETH (not WETH) before WETH deposit. During refund callback, ENTERED bit is set → any re-entrant AMM call reverts. WETH balance unaffected by native ETH refund. Balance check validates WETH delta.

calculateFixedInput: two-step mulDiv (floor). calculateFixedOutput: two-step mulDivRoundingUp (ceil). Round-trip always loses: forward truncates output DOWN, reverse inflates required input UP. Max precision loss: 2 units per call. Fuzz verified.

Flash loan requires repayment + fee (mulDivRoundingUp). Adding/removing liquidity to capture LP fees from own swaps: LP income = LPfee - protocolLPFee, cost = exchangeFee + protocolExchangeFee + 2*protocolLPFee + flashLoanFee. Always net negative.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Protocol fee BPS > MAX_BPS causing unchecked underflow
ruled_out_vectors.reason: protocolFeeBPS validated at write time in admin setters. Stored as uint16 (max 65535). Even if misconfigured, this is self-inflicted admin config error (FP #4). Cannot be triggered by external users.
Both _collectToken and _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse use executor/provider derived from msg.sender. Can only pull from the transaction initiator's approvals. No third-party drainage path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Slither: Stale balance after WETH deposit (reentrancy-balance)
ruled_out_vectors.reason: balanceInBefore read at L2180 (WETH balance). _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess refunds native ETH then deposits WETH. WETH balance only changes AFTER deposit (L3259). No stale read: balanceInAfter read at L2207 captures the final WETH balance. ENTERED bit prevents re-entry.
False positive — these are Uniswap V3 BitMath optimizations. MSB/LSB verified for all 256 powers of 2 in Forge tests. Known Slither detector limitation with complex bit manipulation.

When denominator > numerator: floor(newShare * num / denom) + boundary check. When denominator <= numerator: ceil(newShare * num / denom). Both conservative for the pool. Unconsumed share captured as unfilled input. Cap at availableLiquidity prevents over-consumption.

newShare floored (conservative). requiredLiquidity ceiled (keeps more consumed). Without allowPartialCross: snaps UP to next boundary (returns less). With allowPartialCross: stays at totalConsumedLiquidity. All directions favor pool.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Protocol fee per-step rounding accumulation in DynamicHelper
ruled_out_vectors.reason: Per-step protocol fee uses mulDivRoundingUp (rounds UP per tick crossing). Over K crossings, protocol gains at most K extra wei vs computing on total. For K=5 and millions of swaps: millions of wei = $1e-12 for 18-decimal tokens. Dust-level, not economically significant.

CLOB uses mulDivRoundingUp for output (rounds UP against maker). At 1:1 price, 1 wei input produces >= 1 wei output. At max uint128 input, no revert. Rounding favors taker over maker (standard market convention).

Patterns currentHeight/precision*precision at lines 319, 342 are intentional: aligning heights to precision boundaries. remaining/liquidity*liquidity at lines 1799-1800 computes complete height intervals. No value extraction possible — always rounds toward less liquidity returned.
